summary: Read the two-page A4 curriculum vitae, switch its language, and download it as a PDF.
preconditions: You opened the CV from **Download CV** on the portfolio, or went straight to `/#/cv`.
Your browser allows downloads from this site.

steps.title: Find the CV controls
steps.userInstruction: Use the bar at the top of the page to choose a language (**English**, **中文**, **Melayu**) or click **Download PDF**.
steps.expectedOutcome: The current language is highlighted. The bar is only on screen: it does not appear in the printout or the PDF.

steps.title: Read page 1: profile, education, skills and career
steps.userInstruction: The left column of page 1 has contact details, degrees and core skills. The right column lists professional experience, newest first.
steps.expectedOutcome: Page 1 shows the CV photo, 3 degrees, 12 core skills and every role, each with its dates.

steps.title: Read page 2: research, publications and references
steps.userInstruction: Scroll down to page 2 for research experience, selected publications, extracurricular activities, affiliations and references.
steps.expectedOutcome: Page 2 lists 5 publications with Dr. Chia's name in bold, plus 2 references.

steps.title: Change the CV language
steps.userInstruction: Click **中文** or **Melayu** in the top bar.
steps.expectedOutcome: The whole CV is translated without reloading the page, and it still fits on exactly two A4 pages.

steps.title: Download the CV as a PDF
steps.userInstruction: Click **Download PDF** and keep the tab open until the file has downloaded.
steps.expectedOutcome: The button changes to **Generating PDF...** for a few seconds, `CV_Chia_Min_Yan.pdf` is downloaded, and the button goes back to **Download PDF** so you can download again.
steps.notes: The PDF is generated in your browser at high resolution, so it can take a few seconds on slower devices.

faqAndTroubleshooting.scenario: The Download PDF button says "Generating PDF..."
faqAndTroubleshooting.resolution: The PDF is being built in your browser. This usually takes 2–3 seconds. Stay on the tab; the button comes back once the download starts.

faqAndTroubleshooting.scenario: Printing with Ctrl/Cmd + P adds headers or a third page
faqAndTroubleshooting.userMessage: The print preview shows browser headers or spills onto a 3rd page.
faqAndTroubleshooting.resolution: Use **Download PDF** instead: it always gives a clean two-page A4 PDF. If you do print, turn off "Headers and footers" and set the margins to "Default".

faqAndTroubleshooting.scenario: The CV opened in a different language from the portfolio
faqAndTroubleshooting.userMessage: The language in the CV does not match the portfolio.
faqAndTroubleshooting.resolution: Open the CV with **Download CV** on the portfolio: the link carries your current language (`?lang=`). You can also pick a language in the CV's top bar.
